units.source_text: 且说常陆守夫人正在悄悄地准备一切事宜：

en.t: Meanwhile, the wife of the Governor of Hitachi was quietly making all the preparations.

units.source_text: 叫众侍女一律改穿新装，把房间装饰得焕然一新；

en.t: She had all the serving women change into new clothes, and decorated the room until it looked completely renewed.

units.source_text: 叫浮舟洗头，整理服装，打扮得非常美丽，

en.t: She had Ukifune wash her hair, arrange her clothes, and adorn herself so beautifully

units.source_text: 令人觉得即使嫁给像少将这样身份的人也是可惜的。

en.t: that one felt it would be a pity even to marry her to a man of the Lesser Captain's rank.

units.source_text: 夫人仔细寻思：“这孩子真可怜啊！

en.t: The lady thought carefully to herself, "How pitiable this child is!

units.source_text: 假使她父亲当年收留了她，让她在自己身边长大，

en.t: If only her father had taken her in then and raised her at his own side,

units.source_text: 那么即使父亲死了，薰大将所说的事——虽然很不敢当——我怎么会不答应呢？

en.t: then even after her father's death, how could I refuse what General Kaoru proposed, though it is far more than we deserve?

units.source_text: 可是现在，只有我们自己知道她出身高贵，外人都不把她看作常陆守的亲生女儿。

en.t: But now only we ourselves know that she is of noble birth, while outsiders do not even regard her as the Governor of Hitachi's true daughter.

units.source_text: 知道实情的人，反而为了当初八亲王不肯收留而看轻她。

en.t: Those who know the truth, on the contrary, look down on her because Prince Hachi refused to take her in at the time.
When I think it over, it is truly very sad!"

units.source_text: 又想：“事已如此，无可奈何了。

en.t: Then she thought again, "Things have come to this, and there is nothing to be done.

units.source_text: 女子过了盛年不嫁，终非所宜。

en.t: For a woman to pass her prime without marrying is, after all, not fitting.

units.source_text: 这少将出身不算贱，人品也还好，

en.t: This Lesser Captain is not of low birth, and his character is fairly good as well.

units.source_text: 如此诚恳求婚，我就许了他吧。”

en.t: Since he has proposed so earnestly, I will consent to him."
She firmly made up her mind.

units.source_text: 这是由于那个媒人花言巧语，妇女们更易轻信，因此上了他的当。

en.t: This was because the matchmaker used honeyed words, and women were all the more easily taken in, so she fell for his scheme.
